title: Assets
html:
The listing of material and non-material resources associated with the Kamailio project, made available by individuals or companies for the benefit or protection of the project and its ecosystem.

Domains:

  • kamailio.org – main website – sponsored by Daniel-Constantin Mierla and asipto.com
  • kamailio.cloud – safety acquisition – sponsored by Fred Posner and palner.com
  • kamailio.com – safety acquisition – sponsored by Daniel-Constantin Mierla and asipto.com
  • kamailio.dev – development services – sponsored by Fred Posner and palner.com
  • kamail.io – safety acquisition – sponsored by Fred Posner and palner.com
  • sip-router.org – historical acquisition – sponsored by Jan Janak and asipto.com

Servers:

  • main web server (www.kamailio.org) – sponsored by voztele.com
  • Debian/Ubuntu repository (deb.kamailio.org) – sponsored by sipwise.com, package generation by Victor Seva
  • RPM repository (rpm.kamailio.org) – sponsored by lod.com, package generation by Sergey Safarov
  • backup and testing servers – sponsored by lod.com

Source Code Organization:

  • github.com/kamailio – free cloud hosting

Trademarks:

  • Kamailio trademark in European Union – sponsored by Henning Westerholt and gilawa.com
  • Kamailio trademark in United States of America – sponsored by Henning Westerholt and gilawa.com

Any public request related to one of them (e.g., unavailability, broken links) must be addressed via email to <sr-dev@lists.kamailio.org>. Requests that require privacy (e.g., security reports) must be addressed via email to <management@kamailio.org>. Do not address the individuals or the companies for matters related to these resources.

Any other resources using kamailio as part of their name (e.g., domains in other TLDs, company or project names) are not officially associated with the Kamailio project and do not represent the project at all.
